- **Juri (Acceptance):** Risuku o shonin shi, hassei shita baai no yobi-hi ya yobi-jikan o kamaete oku.

Risuku wa henka shimasu. Teiki-teki ni risuku risuto o kakunin shi, atarashii risuku ga nai ka, taio-saku ga kiko shite iru ka o chekku shimasu.

5. **Komyunikeshon (Communication):**
Sute-ku-horuda to toumei ni joho o kyoyu shi, risuku no joutai o shinkou houkoku suru koto ga, project no seiko ni wa fukaketsu desu.

Kano na mondai wo subete asaishidashimasu. Brainstorming ya kaku-sho no kensho ga yukudachi masu.

2. Risku no bunseki (Risk Analysis):
Kaku risuku no hassei kakuritsu to, sore ga okita toki no eikyo-do wo hyoka shimasu. Kore ni yori, yusen jun'i wo kimemasu.

3. Taiko keikaku no sakusei (Risk Response Planning):
Risuku ni taisuru shisaku wo kimetemasu.
- Kaihi (Avoidance): Risuku no gen'in wo yokete, hassei wo fusegu.
- Keigen (Mitigation): Eikyo ya kakuritsu wo chiisaku suru.
- Tenko (Transfer): Hoken ya soutaku ni yotte risuku wo utsusu.
- Jushou (Acceptance): Risuku wo ukeire, hassei shita toki no taio wo kangaeru.

4. Monitaringu to kontororu (Monitoring and Control):
Keikaku wo teiki teki ni kakunin shi, atarashii risuku ga nai ka chekku shimasu.

Kore ra wo rinari ni okonau koto de, purojekuto no seiko ritsu wo takameru koto ga dekimasu.
